title: BPW-2026-0559
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0559
CD 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14
The Mayor and City Council have approved and authorized the Board of Public Works, on behalf of the Bureau of Sanitation, to execute the Measure W Safe, Clean Water Program - Regional Program Transfer Agreement between the City of Los Angeles and the Los Angeles County Flood Control District for the annual receipt of Measure W Funds for the Round 6 Project.
(REF: BPW-2026-0235)
